bots.name: Taboun V1
bots.change: The intentionally simple baseline. It scores no point at real time controls, so it is listed unrated instead of anchoring the scale.

bots.name: Taboun V2
bots.summary: Searches with minimax and evaluates material.
bots.change: Introduces forward search and material-aware decisions. Fixed at 1000 as the origin of the relative rating scale.

bots.name: Taboun V3
bots.summary: Uses minimax with a simplified positional evaluation.
bots.change: Adds piece-square knowledge instead of counting material alone.

bots.name: Taboun V4
bots.summary: Searches three plies with alpha-beta pruning.
bots.change: Prunes irrelevant branches while preserving the V3 evaluation.

bots.name: Taboun V5
bots.summary: Orders captures and checks before quiet moves.
bots.change: Makes alpha-beta pruning more effective through move ordering.

bots.name: Taboun V6
bots.summary: Extends tactical capture sequences with quiescence search.
bots.change: Reduces horizon mistakes in volatile positions.

bots.name: Taboun V7
bots.summary: Caches repeated positions in a transposition table.
bots.change: Avoids recalculating positions already visited by V6.

bots.name: Taboun V8
bots.summary: Combines iterative deepening with stronger move ordering.
bots.change: Prioritizes promotions, captures, checks and the previous best move.

bots.name: Taboun V9
bots.summary: Evaluates mobility, pawn structure, king safety and development.
bots.change: Adds a broader positional model to the V8 search.

bots.name: Taboun V10
bots.summary: Manages a move deadline and bounds quiescence search.
bots.change: Returns the last completed depth instead of overrunning its clock.

bots.name: Taboun V11
bots.summary: Uses a Polyglot opening book before the V10 search.
bots.change: Adds varied, established opening play; the book is disabled in the arena.

bots.name: Taboun V12
bots.summary: Scores mate distance and stores best moves in its search cache.
bots.change: Prefers faster mates and improves transposition-table move ordering.
